title: Home practical guide and safety card: card holes test
subject: Science
source: Written for science/y6 lesson 1 (Home practical guide and safety card: card holes test (portal worksheet; never shine torches into eyes))
intro: Lesson 1: Light travels in straight lines. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To show that light travels in straight lines
equipment: A hole punch (or adult makes holes)
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Make a hole in the same place in each card
Stand the cards in clay in a straight line
Shine the torch through the holes at a wall; never into eyes
Look for the spot of light
Move the middle card a little to one side
Record what happens and explain it

head: Cards
Light reaches the wall? (yes or no)

questions.q: Big question: why can't you see round a corner?
questions.a: Light travels in straight lines, so it cannot bend round to reach your eyes.
